note: Town of Sylvan Lake campground (opened 2024) in Pogadl Park, the town's sports complex about 1 km south of the lake: a strip of back-to-back sites beside the Co-operators Play Zone & Splash Park, in walking distance of the Gulls baseball stadium and diamonds. --Claude
